assistant: The upstream OpenClaw gateway holds the Signal conversation, and this repository's door (`apps/assistant`) triages alerts, decides what reaches a phone and serves the gateway its tools. `signal-cli` is the Signal account both use. It ships empty: no people, no memory.
caddy: `caddy`, ports 80 and 443, the only container with public ports. It gets its own Let's Encrypt certificates and asks oauth2-proxy about every request to a private subdomain. **Watch out:** it deletes any `Remote-User` header the browser sent, which is why an app can trust that header.
deploy: `harness-auto-deploy.timer`, every two minutes, plus the push webhook, runs `infra/auto-deploy/auto-deploy.sh`. It picks one commit, the gate tests it in its own tree, and only the changed services are rebuilt and must boot. Red or amber ships nothing. The eject ships off.
github: Holds `main`, the issues and the Projects board. A push to `main` fires the webhook at `deploy.$DOMAIN/hooks/deploy`. The server posts each commit's `vm/gate`, `vm/build`, `vm/boot` and `vm/deploy` status back to its commit page.
gpu: Optional. A Scaleway Kapsule cluster whose GPU pools scale to zero, so a node bills only while it transcribes. Notulen submits a Kubernetes Job; the worker writes its result to the stack's Postgres, which then listens beyond the server with only its password as guard.
laptop: Claude Code running in this repository, with the harness: skills, guards, overlays and the code index. Every change starts here as one conversation; open this box for the loop it follows. Nothing deploys from the laptop.
notulen: `notulen` on `notulen.$DOMAIN`, behind the login. A phone records in five-second chunks; the server stitches them, stores the audio, transcribes, and Claude writes the minutes, committed to `NOTULEN_TARGET_REPO`. CPU transcription works by default and takes hours for a long meeting.
observability: Prometheus evaluates its rules every 30 seconds and probes each subdomain over HTTPS; Alertmanager hands a firing group to the alert-relay, and the relay to the assistant. Deadmen run as systemd timers and page straight to Signal when the assistant itself is down. Loopback only: Prometheus on 9090.
people: The owner and the team. In a browser, one Nextcloud login with a second factor opens every private subdomain; on Signal they talk to the assistant. The public sees only the website at the bare domain.
sso: `nextcloud` on `cloud.$DOMAIN` with its Postgres, and `oauth2-proxy` on `auth.$DOMAIN`. Accounts live here: Nextcloud is the identity provider, oauth2-proxy the client. The login cookie lasts 8 hours, the Nextcloud session behind it 7 days. Files and calendar live here too.
storage: A Scaleway Object Storage bucket (`S3_BUCKET`) for meeting audio. Notulen uploads the stitched recording before any check that could end the session, so every failed job can be retried. **Watch out:** it keeps billing after the server is deleted.
vault: One Scaleway Secret Manager secret holding the whole environment, secrets included. `infra/secrets/push-env.sh` writes a new version from the laptop; the server pulls it every deploy cycle into `$HARNESS_ROOT/harness.env`, mode 600. A failed pull keeps the old file.
website: `website`, nginx serving the static files in `apps/website/` at the bare domain, public. It links `/design/index.css`, so an edit to `design/tokens.css` restyles it together with the documents and the dashboards.
